summarise-escalation-thread.output: Ticket T-48213: The customer reports that the payroll export to CSV fails with an "Export timed out" error for March and April. Agent Ade first suggested exporting smaller date ranges, which works one week at a time, but the customer needs monthly files for their accountant. Ade escalated the issue to engineering, who found that exports over 2,000 rows hit a 30 second limit. The customer followed up because the accountant's filing deadline is Monday. Agent Musa said a fix is in review and offered a manual export as a workaround, which the customer accepted for March and April, to be sent to finance@okafor-logistics.example.
